name: GM: Correct Token Position
command: try { if (!game.user.isGM) throw Error("GM only."); const token=canvas.tokens.controlled[0]?.document; if(!token)throw Error("Select a token first."); const point=await game.fdern.pickPoint(); if(point)await token.move(point,{fdernOverride:true}); } catch(error) { ui.notifications.error(error.message); }
